rules.text: Dear ImGui's SDL3 platform backend and SDL_GPU renderer backend both initialize.
A smoke run presents at least one frame through the SDL_GPU renderer backend.
ImGui_ImplSDLGPU3_PrepareDrawData must be called before the render pass that calls ImGui_ImplSDLGPU3_RenderDrawData.
Dear ImGui's core and backends come from the same commit.

adaptation_notes: Init order inside the systems phase: ImGui::CreateContext, then ImGui_ImplSDL3_InitForSDLGPU, then ImGui_ImplSDLGPU3_Init. The GPU device must already have claimed the window (platform phase).
Shutdown: SDL_WaitForGPUIdle first, then the two backend shutdowns, then ImGui::DestroyContext, then the platform-phase SDL teardown.
The SDL_GPU renderer backend embeds its own shaders, so the composition needs no shader toolchain for this pairing.
